+    (OUT / 'status_' + Path(name)).write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
+    print(name, s, flush=True)
+    return s
+
+def rows_between(start, end, step_m=0.003):
+    start = np.asarray(start, float)
+    end = np.asarray(end, float)
+    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - start[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / step_m)))
+    return np.stack([start + (end-start)*(k/n) for k in range(1, n+1)])
+
+def move(r, current, xyz, *, speed_step=0.003, video='none', cameras=[]):
+    end = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, float), Q]
+    a = rows_between(current, end, speed_step)
+    # Keep each request below both client limits; path spacing remains unchanged.
+    for i in range(0, len(a), 390):
+        block = a[i:i+390]
+        res = r.submit('ee_pose', block, dt=DT, video=video, cameras=cameras,
+                       note='RoboPaint strict lettering trajectory')
+        print('submit', res.meta.get('executed_rows'), 'plan', res.meta.get('plan'), flush=True)
+    return end
+
+def stroke(r, current, points, z, step_m=0.00125, note='practice stroke'):
+    current = move(r, current, [points[0][0], points[0][1], z], speed_step=0.003)
+    for p in points[1:]:
+        current = move(r, current, [p[0], p[1], z], speed_step=step_m)
+    # Retract before changing position so disconnected marks are separate contacts.
+    current = move(r, current, [current[0], current[1], z+0.08], speed_step=0.003)
+    return current
+
+def practice_xy(u, v):
+    s = 0.099393 / 406.0
+    return (-0.1000 - (v-512.0)*s, -0.1856 - (u-256.0)*s)
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    print('protocol', r.spec().get('protocol'), flush=True)
+    print('initial status', r.status(), flush=True)
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[])
